title: AI Resume Screener
abstract: Parses uploaded resumes and ranks candidates against a job description using semantic similarity. Extracts skills and experience automatically and gives recruiters a scored shortlist.
technologies: Python, FastAPI, spaCy, Sentence-Transformers, ChromaDB

title: Smart Irrigation Controller
abstract: Monitors soil moisture, temperature and humidity in real time and switches water pumps on only when crops need it. Sends usage reports and alerts to a farmer's mobile app.
technologies: ESP32, DHT22, MQTT, Node-RED, Firebase

title: Phishing URL Detector
abstract: Classifies URLs as phishing or legitimate using lexical, host-based and content features. Delivered as a browser extension that warns users before a page loads.
technologies: Python, Scikit-learn, Random Forest, Flask, Chrome Extensions API

title: Campus Event Management Portal
abstract: Lets students discover, register for and get reminders about college events, while organizers manage attendance and feedback. Includes QR-code check-in and an admin analytics dashboard.
technologies: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT

title: Fake News Detection System
abstract: Identifies misleading news articles by analyzing writing style and comparing claims against trusted sources. Returns a credibility score with a short explanation.
technologies: Python, BERT, HuggingFace Transformers, Flask, NLTK

title: Blockchain-Based Certificate Verification
abstract: Stores tamper-proof hashes of academic certificates on a blockchain so employers can verify authenticity instantly. Universities issue certificates via a simple web portal.
technologies: Solidity, Ethereum, Hardhat, React, IPFS, Web3.js

title: Real-Time Sign Language Translator
abstract: Recognizes hand gestures from a webcam feed and converts them into text and speech. Aims to help hearing-impaired users communicate with people who do not know sign language.
technologies: Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, TensorFlow, LSTM

title: Intrusion Detection System using Machine Learning
abstract: Analyzes network traffic to detect anomalies and known attack patterns such as DoS and port scans. Displays live alerts on a monitoring dashboard.
technologies: Python, Scikit-learn, Wireshark, NSL-KDD dataset, Streamlit

title: Smart Home Energy Monitor
abstract: Measures power consumption of individual appliances and shows usage trends on a dashboard. Suggests ways to cut electricity bills and alerts users to abnormal consumption.
technologies: Arduino, ESP8266, ACS712 sensor, MQTT, InfluxDB, Grafana

title: Mental Health Support Chatbot
abstract: Provides empathetic conversation and coping exercises for students under stress, and flags high-risk messages for human counselors. Does not replace professional care but offers 24/7 first-level support.
technologies: Python, Rasa, Transformers, PostgreSQL, React

title: Online Examination Proctoring System
abstract: Monitors students during remote exams using face detection, gaze tracking and tab-switch detection. Generates a suspicion report for invigilators after each session.
technologies: Python, OpenCV, Dlib, Flask, WebRTC, SQLite

title: Crop Disease Detection App
abstract: Lets farmers photograph a diseased leaf and receive an instant diagnosis with treatment suggestions. Works offline on low-end Android phones using a compressed model.
technologies: TensorFlow Lite, MobileNetV2, Kotlin, PlantVillage dataset

title: Personal Finance Tracker
abstract: Tracks income and expenses, categorizes transactions automatically and visualizes monthly spending. Sends budget alerts when a category limit is close to being exceeded.
technologies: Django, PostgreSQL, Chart.js, Bootstrap, REST API

title: Secure Password Manager
abstract: Stores user credentials in an encrypted vault protected by a master password with zero-knowledge design. Includes a password strength checker and breach-exposure alerts.
technologies: Python, AES-256, Argon2, SQLite, Tkinter

title: Air Quality Monitoring and Prediction
abstract: Collects PM2.5, CO2 and temperature data from distributed sensor nodes and forecasts pollution levels for the next 24 hours. Publishes a public map of air quality across the city.
technologies: Raspberry Pi, MQ135, PMS5003, LoRa, Prophet, Leaflet.js

title: Semantic Research Paper Search Engine

technologies: Python, FastAPI, ChromaDB, BM25, Sentence-Transformers, React

title: Food Delivery Route Optimizer
abstract: Assigns orders to delivery riders and computes the shortest multi-stop routes to reduce delivery time and fuel use. Simulates different traffic scenarios to compare strategies.
technologies: Python, OR-Tools, Pandas, Google Maps API, Flask

title: Student Performance Predictor
abstract: Predicts which students are at risk of failing using attendance, assignment scores and past grades. Gives teachers early warnings and explains the contributing factors.
technologies: Python, XGBoost, SHAP, Pandas, Streamlit

title: Multiplayer Quiz Game Platform
abstract: Allows teachers to host live quiz sessions where students join with a code and compete in real time. Shows instant leaderboards and exports results for grading.
technologies: Next.js, Socket.IO, Node.js, Redis, Tailwind CSS

title: Drone-Based Forest Fire Detection
abstract: Uses aerial video feeds to detect smoke and flames early and sends GPS coordinates to forest officials. Runs a lightweight detection model suitable for onboard processing.
technologies: Python, YOLOv8, OpenCV, Jetson Nano, MAVLink

title: Voice-Controlled Smart Assistant for Elderly
abstract: Lets elderly users control lights, set medication reminders and call family using simple voice commands. Works with regional accents and a small vocabulary to stay accurate and responsive.
technologies: Python, Vosk, Raspberry Pi, MQTT, Text-to-Speech

title: Chest X-Ray Pneumonia Classifier
abstract: Analyzes chest X-ray images and flags likely pneumonia cases for radiologist review. Highlights the suspicious lung regions using heatmaps so doctors can trust the output.
technologies: Python, PyTorch, ResNet50, Grad-CAM, Streamlit

title: Hospital Appointment Booking System
abstract: Allows patients to book, reschedule and cancel doctor appointments online while staff manage schedules and queues. Sends SMS and email confirmations automatically.
technologies: Angular, Spring Boot, MySQL, Twilio API, JWT

title: Autonomous Line-Following Delivery Robot
abstract: Builds a small robot that follows a marked path inside a building and delivers items between rooms. Stops automatically when obstacles are detected in its way.
technologies: Arduino Uno, IR sensors, Ultrasonic sensor, L298N, C++

title: Augmented Reality Campus Navigator
abstract: Overlays directions and building information on the phone camera view to guide new students around campus. Shows class schedules and room details when a building is scanned.
technologies: Unity, AR Foundation, C#, Firebase, Google Maps SDK

title: Cloud-Based Log Monitoring Dashboard
abstract: Collects logs from multiple microservices, indexes them and shows real-time error rates and latency charts. Sends alerts to Slack when anomalies appear.
technologies: Docker, Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, AWS EC2, Python

title: Cross-Platform Habit Tracker App
abstract: Helps users build daily habits with streaks, reminders and weekly progress charts. Syncs data across devices and works offline.
technologies: Flutter, Dart, Firebase Firestore, SQLite, Local Notifications

title: SQL Injection Vulnerability Scanner

technologies: Python, Requests, BeautifulSoup, SQLite, Flask

abstract: Detects sudden falls in elderly people using motion sensors and instantly alerts caregivers with the person's location. Reduces false alarms by filtering normal daily movements.
technologies: ESP32, MPU6050, GPS NEO-6M, GSM SIM800L, Arduino IDE

title: Stock Price Trend Forecasting
abstract: Predicts short-term stock price movement from historical prices and technical indicators, and compares several models. Displays predictions and accuracy metrics on an interactive dashboard.
technologies: Python, LSTM, Keras, Pandas, yfinance, Plotly

title: Plagiarism Detection for Student Code
abstract: Compares source code submissions to find suspiciously similar programs even after variable renaming or reordering. Gives instructors a similarity report with side-by-side highlights.
technologies: Python, AST parsing, Winnowing algorithm, Flask, React

title: Multilingual Customer Support Chatbot
abstract: Answers common customer queries in English, Hindi and Kannada and escalates complex issues to human agents. Learns from resolved tickets to improve future answers.
technologies: Python, Rasa, IndicNLP, FastAPI, MongoDB

title: Decentralized Voting System

technologies: Solidity, Ethereum, Truffle, React, MetaMask

title: Face Recognition Attendance System
abstract: Marks classroom attendance automatically by recognizing students' faces from a camera feed. Generates monthly attendance reports and alerts for low attendance.
technologies: Python, OpenCV, face_recognition, SQLite, Tkinter

title: Traffic Congestion Prediction
abstract: Analyzes historical traffic data to predict congestion at key junctions by time of day and weather. Suggests alternative routes on a city map dashboard.
technologies: Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Folium, PostgreSQL

title: Real-Time Chat Application with End-to-End Encryption
abstract: Provides private messaging where only the sender and receiver can read messages. Supports group chats and file sharing with encrypted storage.
technologies: Node.js, Socket.IO, Signal Protocol, React, MongoDB

title: Smart Parking Management System
abstract: Detects free and occupied parking slots using sensors and shows live availability on a mobile app. Guides drivers to the nearest empty spot and records parking duration.
technologies: Raspberry Pi, Ultrasonic sensors, MQTT, Flask, React Native

title: Recommendation Engine for Online Courses
abstract: Suggests courses to learners based on their interests, past enrollments and similar users' choices. Combines collaborative and content-based filtering to handle new users.
technologies: Python, Scikit-learn, Surprise, Pandas, FastAPI

abstract: Creates a pixel-art platformer with multiple levels, enemies and a scoring system. Includes a level editor so players can design and share their own stages.
technologies: Unity, C#, Tiled, Aseprite, Cinemachine

title: Real-Time Data Pipeline for Social Media Analytics
abstract: Streams tweets and posts, cleans them and computes live sentiment and trending topics. Stores processed data for historical analysis and reporting.
technologies: Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming, Python, PostgreSQL, Grafana
